purpose: Descriptive conditional/composition audit of impact_load and threat_rank across cycle blocks.

variables.period: cycle_code sorted into three contiguous blocks of unique observed values

support_selection.selection_rule: exact impact level or exact impact x entry_friction cell must have the stated count in every primary period.

impact_only_fixed_distribution_standardi.weights: pooled row shares across all three periods within impact-only common support; target-blind
impact_only_fixed_distribution_standardi.quantile_note: No cell medians are averaged to create pooled quantiles; distribution quantiles are reported per exact stratum.

common_impact_ef_distribution_weighted.weight_definition: Each common exact impact_load x entry_friction cell receives its pooled share across all three periods; within each period, that cell share is divided equally over its rows. Weights use counts only, not threat_rank.

symmetric_decomposition.definition: Delta mean = sum((p_late-p_early)*(mu_early+mu_late)/2) + sum((mu_late-mu_early)*(p_early+p_late)/2), over fixed exact impact_load x entry_friction cells retained by >=30 rows in every block.
symmetric_decomposition.weight_denominator: For each period, p(cell|period) is cell n divided by all rows in retained common-support cells in that period.
symmetric_decomposition.support_exclusion: Rows outside the fixed common cells are excluded; support is selected only from covariate cell counts.

interpretation_limits: These are observed associations and descriptive composition summaries; they do not identify causal effects.
The three blocks are chronological bins of sorted unique cycle_code values, not tested change points.
Support exclusions can alter the population represented; coverage is reported alongside all common-support summaries.
The target distribution is summarized within exact strata; cell medians are not averaged as pooled quantiles.
No TP2 model errors, drift, or break claims are assessed by this analysis.
